notes: PAP reference G10/1035. Whole renovated six-room apartment on the second and top floor of a small central Orleans condominium. The full advert describes an entrance, fitted kitchen and 38 m2 living room, four bedrooms including one with private shower, a bathroom, separate WC and a 17 m2 cellar. The optional double garage is explicitly additional and is not treated as included. It states annual charges of EUR 1,360, district biomass heating, 2024 facade work and DPE C. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 20 September 2026.

PAP reference G51/0770. Whole four-room apartment on the first floor of a six-lot condominium on rue Royale in central Orleans. The full advert describes an entrance, 30 m2 living and dining room, recent kitchen, three bedrooms including one with a shower room, a bathroom and secured courtyard parking. It states the apartment is in excellent condition and annual charges are EUR 1,800. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 17 September 2026. No reliable DPE grade or property tax was exposed.

PAP reference G31/2499. Whole five-room family apartment on the fourth floor with lift in a maintained secured Orleans condominium. The full advert describes a 28 m2 living and dining room, separate fitted kitchen, four bedrooms, bathroom, separate WC, utility storage, cellar, bicycle room and shared drying room. It states no apartment work is required, collective gas heating and DPE D/GES B. PAP exposed 8 property photos and the detail page displayed a publication date of 3 September 2026. The later price reduction is reflected in the current EUR 125,000 price.

PAP reference G51/2932. Whole four-room apartment on the third floor of a four-storey, three-apartment building near place d'Erlon in Reims. The full advert describes three bedrooms, a very sunny exposure, double glazing, parking and bicycle storage, a cellar and recent bathroom, cellar and plumbing work. The advert is a conventional vacant whole-property offer and contains no occupied-sale or special-sale language. PAP exposed 12 property photos and the detail page displayed a publication date of 8 September 2026. No reliable DPE grade, charges or property tax was exposed.

PAP reference G52/1453. Whole renovated three-room apartment in a maintained Troyes condominium. The full advert describes an entrance and storage, fitted open kitchen and living area, principal bedroom with adjoining dressing or child's room and private terrace, second bedroom, bathroom, separate WC, private parking and cellar. It states lift and PMR access, annual charges of EUR 3,840 including heating and water, and availability in September or October 2026. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 17 September 2026. No reliable DPE grade or property tax was exposed.

PAP reference G41/1003. Whole raised-ground-floor T3 to renovate in Troyes' Jules Guesde district. The full advert describes a corridor, separate WC, shower room, living room, separate kitchen, salon convertible to a bedroom, one existing bedroom and a 5.8 m2 cellar. It states individual electric heating and hot water, a 20-lot condominium and property tax of EUR 1,131. Renovation is disclosed without auction or special-sale language. PAP exposed 3 property photos and a publication date of 20 August 2026.

PAP reference G33/2439. Whole furnished studio in central Troyes at place Audiffred. The full advert describes an entrance with fitted storage, bright double-exposure living space, equipped kitchen and recent shower room with WC. It states the apartment and condominium require no work, insulation was renewed two years ago, DPE is D and charges are approximately EUR 45 per month. The advert refers to a previous rent and does not state a current tenant. PAP exposed 7 property photos and the detail page displayed a publication date of 3 September 2026. A malformed property-tax figure was ignored rather than stored.

PAP reference G52/1311. Whole three-room apartment in Evreux. The complete concise advert describes two bedrooms, a balcony over the Iton, a fitted kitchen and dining room opening to another balcony, shower room, one covered and one outdoor parking place, and a secured cellar. DPE is stated as pending and is therefore not asserted. PAP exposed positive property-photo evidence and the detail page displayed a publication date of 10 September 2026.
